The '''Target Imager''' was a computerized [[Scope/Legends|scope]] that used [[ultrasonic beam emitter]]s on different frequencies to create a composite sonic image via a small data analyzer. This form of sighting allowed the user to see through most kinds of cover and concealment for improved aiming. It was manufactured by [[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]].<ref name="BP">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref>
